login_intro: This device is not yet allowed to use vinyl-check. Enter the access code shown on the computer that runs vinyl-check.
login_hint: You find the code in vinyl-check on that computer under Settings → Network access. Scanning the QR code there signs you in directly.
login_locked: Too many wrong codes. Please wait a minute and try again.
access_required: Access code required: open the start page of vinyl-check on this device and enter the code.
bad_host: Unknown host name. Open vinyl-check by the IP address or name of the computer it runs on.
local_only: Network access can only be changed on the computer that runs vinyl-check.
desktop_only: Network access is set up in the configuration file of this installation.
lan_failed: Network access could not be started: {error}
lan_no_port: Network access could not be started: no free network port.
